guide.title: Tyrande's Overview
guide.text:
Tyrande is a ranged Healer that offers an
exceptional amount of utility.
She is capable of providing vision for the rest of her team, healing wounded
teammates, and disrupting enemy Heroes by Stunning
and Slowing them. Tyrande is
a very versatile Hero which allows her to adapt to the course of the game very
well. Her strong crowd control and her ability to keep track of the enemy
team's movements make up for her low Health pool
and lack of mobility.

guide.title: Tyrande's Strengths and Weaknesses
guide.text:
Strengths
Sentinel is a useful scouting Ability
Lunar Flare works incredibly well with other crowd control Abilities
Hunter's Mark significantly increases her team's damage when focusing on a single enemy target
Great single target healing
Access to a low-cooldown cleanse effect at Level 16
Is the only hero that can reliably increase Basic Attack Damage of allies
Weaknesses
Lacks any form of escape ability
Bad waveclear
High learning curve
Requires a lot of map awareness
very susceptible to dives

guide.title: Tyrande's Synergies and Counters
guide.text:
Tyrande synergizes with
Tyrande synergizes very well with Tanks like Diablo,
E.T.C., or Varian, whose
initiation Abilities lay a perfect foundation for
Lunar Flare's Stun effect.
Burst-oriented Assassins can easily
capitalize on Hunter's Mark Armor Reduction, while
Basic Attack-heavy Heroes benefit from Trueshot Aura's
40% damage increase for 5 seconds.
Tyrande is countered by
Tyrande struggles against heavy dive Heroes, that can easily
reach her, such as Anub'arak or Maiev.
Despite that, since Tyrande lacks AoE healing, she also
suffers against Heroes like Fenix or Lunara, that can damage
all of her team at the same time.

guide.title: Tyrande's Maps
guide.text:
Tyrande's stronger maps
Tyrande's average maps
Tyrande's weaker maps
None
Tyrande is great on smaller maps like Dragon Shire or
Tomb of the Spider Queen that focus a lot on
early game rotations. These frequent
skirmishes also help her stack Lunar Flare's Quest
early. Thanks to Hunter's Mark and Lunar Flare, she excels
at taking down enemy Heroes with other crowd control abilities.
Hunter's Mark can also be applied to non-Heroic
targets, such as Bosses, Immortals, or Punishers, which makes Tyrande a
powerful pick on Battlefield of Eternity. When combined with
Trueshot Aura, your team can quickly burn these
high-Health targets during the 40% extra damage window. She is also excellent on
maps where Objectives keep Minions nearby, allowing safer cooldown refunds
while healing her team, such as Infernal Shrines or
Tomb of the Spider Queen.

guide.title: Tyrande's Tips and Tricks
guide.text:
Use Sentinel as frequently as possible. The vision it provides helps your team in making better decisions.
Always mind your positioning when playing Tyrande. If caught by surprise, she is an easy Hero to get taken down.
Shadowstalk is an incredibly versatile Heroic Ability. Use it to ambush the enemy team or to cover your retreat.
Landing Lunar Flare on moving targets requires practice and experience. Try to anticipate their movement paths and aim accordingly.
When low on Mana, use Lunar Flare on Minions or other nearby targets, as hitting 3 or more enemies restores more Mana than the Ability costs.
Hunter's Mark can be used on non-Heroic targets, such as Bosses, Immortals, or Punishers, in order to kill them faster.
To make the most out of your healing, you should be always using basic attacks. In many situations it will be dangerous to do so, and you should be waiting for enemy tank to use his Abilities to start delivering Basic Attacks.
Starfall will greatly reduce Light of Elune's Cooldown. Be ready to use it quickly to not waste any healing.
All of Light of Elune's charges are refilled together, so you can have 1 charge left and start attacking. Use it right before the Cooldown comes back again, giving you 3 uses of the Ability. This is mostly useful against burst damage to surprise your enemies.
Since Sentinel resets on a kill, it is excellent to use it on dying or fleeing targets, being even better after hitting 20 enemies with her Lunar Flare, as you can hit an enemy several times in a fight with its pierce.
See our Abilities page for further information »

guide.title: Tyrande's Role in the Current Meta
guide.text:
Tyrande's potent defensive and offensive skills make her one of the most
flexible Heroes in the game that fits into many team compositions. Although she does
not have the strongest of early game healing, Light of Elune
provides a useful low-cooldown healing Ability that will assist your allies in need,
while Lunar Flare is a very nice follow-up Stun that
can be chained with other crowd control
Abilities.
Tyrande, furthermore, thrives against team compositions
that rely on crowd control, since
her Celestial Attunement
Talent at Level 16 can be used to quickly remove impairing effects and thus has outstanding saving
potential when death timers become dangerously long.
Besides, Sentinel greatly improves your team's vision
which is useful on every Maps in order to act and react to your enemies' movements.
Another aspect that makes Tyrande a very strong pick is her ability to increase
all damage dealt to a single enemy Hero by 15% for 4 seconds using
Hunter's Mark. This allows her
and her teammates to focus and kill priority targets (whether it is an enemy
Hero or a neutral Objective) a lot faster, especially if her team
has good communication.

abilities.text:

abilities.title: Light of Elune
abilities.text:
Light of Elune
(Q)
Tyrande
Mana: 15
Charges: 2
Recharge Time: 16 seconds
Heal an ally Hero for 270 (+4% per level). Light of Elune's cooldown is reduced by 1.5 seconds every time Tyrande hits an enemy with a Basic Attack or damages an enemy Hero.
Stores up to 2 charges. Cooldown replenishes all charges at the same time.
Being Tyrande's only burst heal Ability, Light of Elune is crucial in
order to keep allies and herself alive. Tyrande should use Light of Elune regularly, as the Ability comes with
2 charges. In order to heal with maximum efficiency, it is of utmost importance
to consistently use Basic Attacks with Tyrande, as every attack lowers the cooldown of Light of Elune.

abilities.title: Sentinel
abilities.text:
Sentinel
(W)
Tyrande
Mana: 55
Cooldown: 15 seconds
Send an Owl across the battleground revealing its path, dealing 120 (+4% per level) damage to the first Hero hit, and revealing them for 5 seconds. If a Hero revealed by Sentinel dies, refresh its cooldown.
Sentinel can be used in order to scout if you do not see the opposing team on your
Minimap or before blindly facechecking bushes.
However, keep in mind that in certain situations it may not be the best choice
to use Sentinel. If your team is trying to capture Mercenary Camps or Golem
Bosses for example, an ill timed Owl could tell enemies about your position and
consequently enable them to catch you off guard.
Sentinel resets its cooldown when a Hero dies
while Revealed, so casting it on a target Stunned by
Lunar Flare often makes it available again right
after the kill. Since it does not refund Mana, avoid using it when you are
low on Mana.

abilities.title: Lunar Flare
abilities.text:
Lunar Flare
(E)
Tyrande
Mana: 65
Cooldown: 13 seconds
After 0.75 seconds, deal 150 (+4% per level) damage and Stun enemies in the target area for 0.75 seconds. Restores 25 Mana per enemy hit.
Quest: Hitting a Hero with Lunar Flare increases its damage by 3%, up to 120%. Double this bonus if the Hero dies within 3 seconds.
Reward: After hitting 10 Heroes, increase Lunar Flare's range by 30%.
Reward: After hitting 20 Heroes, Sentinel now pierces the first Hero hit.
Mythic Reward: After hitting 40 Heroes, Every 8th Basic Attacks fires a Lunar Flare, prioritizing Heroes. Attack Range increased by 1.
Lunar Flare is a powerful Ability that adds some great
crowd control to Tyrande's kit. Unlike most other
Healers, Tyrande can be played as a strong ganker.
While Lunar Flare allows Tyrande to disrupt enemies from a safe distance,
the fact that it is a skillshot makes it a skill that
requires a lot of experience in order to be used efficiently. One of the most
important things to keep in mind when using Lunar Flare is to
predict your target's movement path. Anticipating the position of your
target correctly is crucial when playing Tyrande, so do not shy away from practising
against the AI before diving into Hero League or Team League matches.
Lunar Flare restores 25 Mana for each enemy hit,
including Heroes, Minions, Mercenaries, Monsters, and Structures. Because of
this, it can be used to recover Mana when you are running low. Hitting 3 enemies
restores more Mana than the Ability costs, so if no enemy Heroes are nearby,
you can cast it on a Minion wave to clear it faster. Hitting 4 Minions results in a
net gain of 35 Mana, while a stacked wave or a nearby Mercenary can restore
even more.
Tyrande has a Quest tied to Lunar Flare that
progresses whenever it hits enemy Heroes. If a target Hero dies within 3
seconds of being hit by Lunar Flare, Tyrande gains 1 additional stack. Each
stack increases its damage by 3%, so early progress matters. At 10 Hero hits,
it gains additional range, making further stacking easier. At 20 Hero hits,
Sentinel gains piercing, which is essential for
Sentinel-oriented builds. The final milestone at 40 Hero hits is difficult to
reach in most games, but it unlocks the Mythic Reward: Tyrande gains 1
additional Attack Range, allowing her to attack from a safer distance,
and automatically casts Lunar Flare for free
after every 8 Basic Attacks.
Progressing this Quest quickly is important for maximizing Tyrande's
impact. To stack efficiently, you should adapt your play as follows:
Follow up on allied crowd control,
especially from your Tank, to land reliable hits.
When no cc is available, aim it at a
Regeneration Globe that the enemy team is about to pick up.
Look for stacks on enemy-controlled Objectives, such as the Dragon Knight on
Dragon Shire or the Triglav Protector on
Volskaya Foundry.
Level 13 Talents can greatly speed up stacking.
Harsh Moonlight provides a powerful
Slow that helps you land it consistently, while
Ranger's Mark reduces its cooldown, allowing it to be
used far more often and accelerating Quest progress.
After completing the Quest, you can prepare the automatic cast by
attacking Minions or Heroes 7 times. Then, wait for allied
crowd control to hit an enemy Hero and follow up
with it. A single Basic Attack on the Stunned target will
trigger the next cast, adding another Stun on top of your chain.

abilities.title: Starfall
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Starfall
(R)
Tyrande
Heroic
Mana: 85
Cooldown: 80 seconds
Deal 92 (+4% per level) damage per second and Slow enemies by 20% in an area. Lasts 6 seconds.
Starfall damages and Slows every enemy
in its area of effect, which makes it
a very powerful Heroic Ability during team fights and pushes.
As soon as a team fight breaks out, Starfall should be first Abilitiy to be cast. Doing so
maximizes the damage output during the fight and provides Tyrande with cooldown reduction
on her Light of Elune. One of Starfall's greatest
advantages is its versatility, because it can be used both offensively and
defensively. If used offensively, Starfall is able to Slow retreating enemies
which allows your teammates to collapse on them. If used defensively, Starfall
can be used to disengage and run away from charging enemies.

abilities.title: Shadowstalk
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Shadowstalk
(R)
Tyrande
Heroic
Mana: 85
Cooldown: 90 seconds
Grant all allied Heroes Stealth for 10 seconds and heal them for 380 (+4% per level) Health over 10 seconds. Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.
Shadowstalk is a useful supportive Heroic Ability, which provides
significant healing to your allies. Furthermore,
it allows Tyrande to initiate hidden manoeuvres on the battlefield to catch the enemy
team off guard.
On bigger Maps like Cursed Hollow or Sky Temple on which it is harder for the enemy
team to predict your position, Shadowstalk can gain a lot of value. On smaller
Maps like Towers of Doom or Tomb of the Spider Queen,
however, the strong area of effect damage
from Starfall can sometimes be the better choice.

abilities.title: Hunter's Mark
abilities.text:
Hunter's Mark
(D)
Tyrande
Cooldown: 20 seconds
Reveal a non-Structure enemy and reduce their Armor by 15 for 4 seconds.
Passive: Tyrande's Basic Attacks heal her for 1% of her maximum Health, doubled against targets with Hunter's Mark.
Tyrande's Hunter's Mark is one of the strongest Traits in the game when it
comes to taking down a single target very quickly. It synergises extremely well
with both Tyrande's own and her allies' sources of burst damage. Hunter's Mark can
even cause enemy Tanks and Bruisers
to become relatively squishy targets, which forces
them to think carefully about engaging a team fight or not.
Keep in mind that Hunter's Mark can be used to greatly increase
Lunar Flare's and Sentinel's damage
as well. Since it has the same casting range as Lunar Flare, we recommend marking your
chosen target first before hitting it with your other Abilities in order to
maximise your overall damage.

talent_pages.title: Discussion
talent_pages.text:
Ranger greatly increases Sentinel's damage.
However, it requires the second milestone of Lunar Flare's
Quest (hitting 20 Heroes) to be completed before it becomes impactful. As a
result, it is mostly a late-game option, especially
when paired with Commander of Sentinels at Level 20.
Moonlit Arrows is the only option in this tier that
directly increases your healing frequency. However, unlike the other two
options, it is mainly valuable in the early game,
as it has limited synergy with other Talents.
Trueshot Aura is a strong Talent because the
Hunter's Mark cooldown reset alone provides
significant value and has excellent synergy with other Mark-oriented Talents.
On top of that, the 40% damage increase for 5 seconds is a major bonus that
helps your team quickly burst an immobilized
target.

talent_pages.title: Discussion
talent_pages.text:
Everlasting Light is the only option in this tier
that improves your healing when you cannot reliably hit enemies with Basic
Attacks. However, unlike the other options, it does not increase healing when
you are forced to repeatedly heal a single target, which can be crippling
when trying to keep an ally alive.
Mark of Mending is excellent with a good frontline, as it
constantly heals 4% of maximum Health of your whole team. It also excels in
Battlefield of Eternity, in which it can be used at Immortal
to quickly heal your whole team. However, if your team has Heroes that demand
good single-target healing, Elune's Chosen will still
be a better option.
Elune's Chosen is a great Talent, not
necessarily because of Tyrande's strong Basic Attacks, but more
because of its long duration of 8 seconds and its
relatively short cooldown of 30 seconds. The additional single-target healing,
over time, really adds up and adds some great utility to Tyrande during team
fights.

Elune's Gift
(Level 7)
Tyrande
Mana: 65
Cooldown: 13 seconds
Hitting an enemy Hero with Lunar Flare grants 20% Spell Power for 10 seconds.
?
Kaldorei Resistance
(Level 7)
Tyrande
Light of Elune grants the target 10 Spell Armor for 2 seconds. This effect stacks up to 2 times.
✓
Huntress' Fury
(Level 7)
Tyrande
Tyrande's Basic Attacks against targets with Hunter's Mark bounce to nearby enemy Heroes.
Passive: Increase Hunter's Mark duration by 1 second, and its cast range by 25%.

talent_pages.title: Discussion
talent_pages.text:
Elune's Gift is a good Talent when paired with
Ranger. However, it is not recommended for a
Lunar Flare build, as that build relies more on
Hunter's Mark Talents to enable frequent cooldown
resets.
Kaldorei Resistance is a good Talent and can be picked
against heavy Mage compositions that exclusively rely on Ability damage.
Huntress' Fury's splash damage is not always noticeable, and it does
not interact with Elune's Chosen, but it greatly reduces the cooldown of
Light of Elune. This Talent is excellent when paired with
Trueshot Aura, as the extra damage and the extra Hunter's Mark
increase its efficacy. Furthermore, with this Talent you can use your Hunter's Mark on Minions or Mercenaries
close to enemy Heroes, to maximize the Cooldown Reduction of Light of Elune
when attacking that marked target.

talent_pages.title: Level 10 Talents for Tyrande
talent_pages.text:
?
Shadowstalk
(Level 10)
Tyrande
Mana: 85
Cooldown: 90 seconds
Grant all allied Heroes Stealth for 10 seconds and heal them for 380 (+4% per level) Health over 10 seconds. Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.
✓
Starfall
(Level 10)
Tyrande
Mana: 85
Cooldown: 80 seconds
Deal 92 (+4% per level) damage per second and Slow enemies by 20% in an area. Lasts 6 seconds.

talent_pages.title: Discussion
talent_pages.text:
In this section we discuss when and why to pick a given Heroic Ability.
If you want to read how they work in detail and/or you are looking for some tips on how to use them,
check them out on the Abilities and Strategy page.
Shadowstalk
is a strong Heroic Ability for two major reasons. Firstly, it enhances Tyrande's and her allies'
escape capabilities significantly. Secondly, it allows experienced players and teams to execute deadly
ambushes and ganks on enemy Heroes.
Starfall provides Tyrande with a strong zoning tool.
Being able to Slow and damage multiple enemies at
the same time for 8 seconds is especially useful when fighting over static
Objectives such as Temples or Tributes. Thus, we recommend casting Starfall on
narrow terrain and choke points in order to make it
harder for the enemy to escape. Keep in mind that every hit of Starfall also lowers the cooldown
of Light of Elune, which can drastically increase Tyrande's healing output.
It is excellent against heavy melee compositions as well.

talent_pages.title: Level 13 Talents for Tyrande
talent_pages.text:
?
Quickening Blessing
(Level 13)
Tyrande
Gain 5% Movement Speed. Light of Elune increases the target's Movement Speed by 25% for 3 seconds.
?
Harsh Moonlight
(Level 13)
Tyrande
Sentinel Slows enemies hit by 35% and reduces their damage dealt by 35% for 3 seconds.
✓
Ranger's Mark
(Level 13)
Tyrande
Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Hunter's Mark by 2 second. Basic Attacks against marked targets reduce the cooldown of Lunar Flare by 4 seconds.

talent_pages.title: Discussion
talent_pages.text:
Quickening Blessing's value depends more
on your team composition than on build. It can be a good
choice with Heroes who benefit a lot from extra Movement Speed, such as
Sgt. Hammer, Garrosh, or Arthas.
Harsh Moonlight is a strong Talent that can be used to reduce a Hero's damage by
a significant amount. However, it can also be used offensively since it Slows the target,
allowing your team to chase it down or follow up with
crowd control.
Ranger's Mark is an excellent Talent when paired
with Trueshot Aura, as it significantly boosts
Tyrande's damage, crowd control potential, and
Lunar Flare Quest completion speed. However, do not
force risky positioning just to get Lunar Flare
resets, as overstepping can lead to unnecessary deaths.

talent_pages.title: Level 16 Talents for Tyrande
talent_pages.text:
✓
Celestial Attunement
(Level 16)
Tyrande
Light of Elune removes Stuns, Silences, and Slows from its target.
?
Empower
(Level 16)
Tyrande
Reduce Sentinel's cooldown by 3 seconds. Heroes hit by Sentinel takes bonus damage equal to 6% of their maximum Health.
?
Darnassian Archery
(Level 16)
Tyrande
Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes grant a stacking 12% increased Attack Damage bonus for 4 seconds.

talent_pages.title: Discussion
talent_pages.text:
Celestial Attunement allows Tyrande to counter
crowd control efficiently, as it removes
Stuns, Slows, and
Silences (including Taunt and Fear).
This makes it valuable against Heroes such as Varian and Muradin.
However, it does not cleanse Roots
or Blinds. If the enemy team has few Stuns, Slows, or Silences,
another Talent is usually better.
Empower is a solid Talent. The cooldown reduction comes in handy, while the
additional percent-based damage adds a bit
of extra damage, which is always appreciated. Go for
it if enemies do not have crowd controls for you to worry about.
Darnassian Archery's damage amplification is very noticeable
after a few stacks. However, if you want more reliable output,
Empower usually offers more consistent value through its flat damage and
cooldown reduction.

talent_pages.title: Level 20 Talents for Tyrande
talent_pages.text:
?
Eyes of the Huntress
(Level 20)
Tyrande
Shadowstalk reveals all enemy Heroes for 10 seconds and heals for 100% more.
✓
Celestial Wrath
(Level 20)
Tyrande
Increase the Slow of Starfall to 60% and cause it to apply Hunter's Mark to enemy Heroes while inside of its area of effect.
?
Commander of Sentinels
(Level 20)
Tyrande
Sentinel gains a 2nd charge.
?
Iceblade Arrows
(Level 20)
Tyrande
Increase Attack Speed by 20%. Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes reduce their damage dealt by 8% for 2 seconds. This effect stacks up to 5 times.

talent_pages.title: Discussion
talent_pages.text:
Eyes of the Huntress is a valuable Talent in games where
Tyrande is not able to attack frequently, as it grants good healing regardless
of the situation.
Celestial Wrath is a powerful upgrade to
Starfall against most compositions. It applies free
Hunter's Marks, making it an excellent choice with
other Mark-oriented Talents. It is especially effective into low-mobility
teams, as the added Slow makes
Lunar Flare hits more reliable. If the enemy team is
very mobile, the other options are usually better.
Commander of Sentinels is an excellent Talent, but
it is not always the best pick. It becomes impactful only after you complete the
second milestone of Lunar Flare's Quest (hitting
20 Heroes). It also requires some Sentinel
Talents, such as Empower or
Harsh Moonlight, to provide consistent value.
Iceblade Arrows is a decent Talent against heavy mobility Heroes
which will likely dive your teammates, such as Genji or Greymane.
With it, you can greatly reduce their effectiveness, since you will not be able to retreat against them.
